claims.statement: The repository requires Node.js >=22.0.0 and <25.0.0 with npm >=9.0.0, enforced via the root package.json engines field; the Dockerfile's default base image is node:22-bookworm-slim, exposed as an overridable ARG NODE_IMAGE that deploy-vps.sh pins to a resolved digest.

npm install at the repository root installs all npm workspaces (packages/*) in a single pass; better-sqlite3 compiles a native addon during install when no prebuilt binary exists, requiring python3/make/g++ — the Dockerfile installs this toolchain in both the build stage and (transiently) the production npm ci --omit=dev layer, then purges make/g++.

npm run dev uses npm-run-all --parallel to start dev:server (tsx watch src/index.ts in @djimitflo/server) and dev:dashboard (vite) concurrently; the Vite dev server runs on port 5173 and proxies /api and /ws to the backend at localhost:3001.

The root build script is an explicit chained workspace order: shared, telegram, agent-catalog, mcp-server, ransomware-module, server, dashboard. Downstream packages consume workspace dependencies through their built dist outputs (e.g. @djimitflo/shared exports dist/index.js and dist/index.d.ts), so the order matters; the dashboard's Vite config is the exception, aliasing @djimitflo/shared directly to shared/src.

The server package runs tsx watch src/index.ts in dev and node dist/index.js (compiled by tsc) via start; in production the server serves the built dashboard from DASHBOARD_PATH instead of the Vite dev server.

The root npm run test pipeline runs a battery of script-level selftests BEFORE any workspace test (deploy-vps.selftest.sh, wiki-delta-emitter.selftest.sh, live-identity-evidence, integration-probes, gen-agent-docs --check + .test, gym-worker --selfcheck + .test + -research.test, kb-sync, mutation-gain, oracle-gate + oracle-gate-replay, ci-workflows, host-scripts-dry-run, benchmark-run), then builds shared and agent-catalog, then npm run test --workspaces --if-present, and finally npm run test:skill-packages (node --test skills/*). The paperclip-archive-export and paperclip-readonly-monitor selftests are no longer part of the pipeline.

test:changed first builds @djimitflo/shared and @djimitflo/agent-catalog, then runs vitest --changed across five workspaces (server, shared, agent-catalog, mcp-server, dashboard) rather than only the server workspace; the root vitest.config.mts selects the jsdom environment with no setup files, and the dashboard configures jsdom with globals.

The root type-check script first builds shared, agent-catalog, mcp-server, and ransomware-module (whose dist declarations are type-resolution targets for downstream workspaces) and then runs type-check across all workspaces with --if-present; lint runs eslint per workspace with --if-present.

db:migrate and db:seed run via tsx (no build of server required): migrate resolves resolveDbPath() (DB_PATH, else DJIMITFLO_DB, else <repo>/.data/djimitflo.sqlite) and executes runMigrations, but only self-executes when it is the direct entry point (require.main === module AND argv[1] matches migrate.[cm]?[jt]s), so a bundled operator script never migrates DB_PATH as a side effect; seed populates mock agents via initializeDatabase(). Normal server startup applies the same schema through initializeDatabase(), so these scripts exist to provision a database without booting the API.

Server development config comes from packages/server/.env.example: dev uses a default JWT secret with a warning while production refuses to start without JWT_SECRET (validateEnv in config/env.ts); AUTH_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD create a bootstrap admin only when no users exist; DJIMITFLO_RUNTIME_PROFILE (api/operator/autonomous) gates operator integrations, maintenance loops, the loop daemon, and autonomous services in index.ts.

The Dockerfile is a two-stage build on an overridable ARG NODE_IMAGE=node:22-bookworm-slim (deploy-vps.sh passes a resolved digest). Both stages pin apt resilience (Acquire::Retries, bounded timeouts, ForceIPv4). The builder installs python3/make/g++ for better-sqlite3, caches manifests, runs npm ci, then the npm run build workspace chain. The runner upgrades the base and installs ca-certificates git python3-minimal curl procps libatomic1, pins the gh CLI as a static .deb (ARG GH_CLI_VERSION=2.102.1, gh --version probed), installs a version+sha256-pinned Atomic Agent gym-maker runtime (ARG ATOMIC_AGENT_VERSION=0.6.5, sha256sum -c verified, atomic-agent --version probed), pins global agent runtime CLIs @openai/codex@0.146.0, opencode-ai@1.18.10 and @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.282 (git/codex/opencode/claude --version probed), creates non-root djimitflo uid/gid 1001 and a reserved maker uid/gid 1002, chowns /data, runs production npm ci --omit=dev with better-sqlite3 smoke-tested in-memory before purging make/g++, pins npm 12.0.2 with dependency patches, copies built dist plus runtime-read content (agent-catalog schema, specs/, openspec/changes, explainer corpus, negative-evidence registry, usage-plan limits, finding-fix gate + ESLint toolchain), bakes build provenance env vars (DJIMITFLO_COMMIT_SHA/BUILD_COMMIT/BUILD_SHA/BUILD_TIME/BUILD_SOURCE from VCS_REF/BUILD_TIME/BUILD_SOURCE plus DJIMITFLO_BUILD_LOCK_SHA256 and DJIMITFLO_BUILD_BASE_IMAGE) declared after the heavy layers to preserve cache, and ends with EXPOSE 3001, /health healthcheck, USER djimitflo, VOLUME /data, ENTRYPOINT docker-entrypoint.sh, CMD node packages/server/dist/index.js.

docker-entrypoint.sh creates /data and BACKUP_DIR (default /data/backups) if missing, prints startup info, hard-fails with exit 1 when NODE_ENV=production and JWT_SECRET is unset, and finally execs the container CMD so the node process replaces the shell.

docker-compose.yml declares a single djimitflo service that builds from the Dockerfile, publishes ${DJIMITFLO_HOST_PORT:-3001}:3001, loads env from .env.docker, mounts the named volume djimitflo-data at /data, restarts unless stopped, and healthchecks http://localhost:3001/health every 30s; /data holds the SQLite database (/data/djimitflo.sqlite) and backups (/data/backups), making the volume the persistence contract across container replacement.

Within the root npm run test pipeline, the leading script selftests cover: deploy-vps.selftest.sh (fixture-compose checks of scripts/deploy-vps.sh — image/commit/mount rewrite, chown before recreate, rollback), wiki-delta-emitter.selftest.sh, live-identity-evidence.test.mjs (assurance:live commit/instance/loopback-vs-database identity), integration-probes.test.mjs (stubbed-fetch Context7 MCP probes), gen-agent-docs --check + .test (generated TOOLS.md/HEARTBEAT.md/config-defaults.generated.ts drift), gym-worker --selfcheck/.test/-research.test, kb-sync.test.mjs, mutation-gain.test.mjs (OPS-001 fail-closed), oracle-gate + oracle-gate-replay, ci-workflows.test.mjs, host-scripts-dry-run.test.mjs, and benchmark-run.test.mjs; the paperclip-archive-export.py / paperclip-readonly-monitor.py steps have been removed.

The repository defines two Stryker mutation lanes: test:mutation runs stryker run against stryker.config.js (curated critical code spans in approval-service, tool-broker, docker-sandbox-executor and runtime-governance, StringLiteral/ObjectLiteral excluded, vitest runner with vitest.mutation.config.ts limited to six named server test files, score thresholds high 85 / low 75 / break 70), and test:mutation:grounded runs node scripts/mutation-gain.mjs.

scripts/mutation-gain.mjs (test:mutation:grounded) requires MUTATE_FILE (source to mutate) and MUTATE_TEST (test under evaluation); it runs Stryker twice via stryker.service.config.mjs — once against the committed HEAD version of the test written to a temporary .mutation-baseline.test.ts, once against the working-tree test — and exits 0 only when the after score gains at least MUTATE_MIN_GAIN points (default 10) or reaches 90. It fails closed (OPS-001): an unreadable HEAD, a baseline that cannot be measured, or a failed working-tree run are never treated as a 0 score; only a test file genuinely absent at HEAD starts from 0, and every outcome prints one JSON line with a status and null score when unknown. When either MUTATE_FILE or MUTATE_TEST is unset it prints a skip message and exits 0 so hosts can list it unconditionally in loop-daemon check scripts.

stryker.service.config.mjs mutates exactly the MUTATE_FILE path, reports JSON to MUTATE_REPORT (default a tmpdir file), and points the vitest runner at vitest.service-mutation.config.ts, a node-environment config whose include is solely [process.env.MUTATE_TEST ?? 'none'] with a 30s timeout, so only the single test file under scrutiny runs against the mutants.

The gh CLI is installed in the runner image because the server's PR-review service shells out to it for PR comments and Check Runs (GithubPrReviewService), and the global agent runtimes are pinned to keep the production worker surface equal to the runtimes accepted by /swarms/runtime-readiness; the Dockerfile comments state both rationales.
